data.text: GOALS MAP: A RING FOR EVERY SIGNATURE (18) AND AN ODD ONE FOR EVERY FAMILY (7). GOALS DONE HERE COUNT, GIVE LETTERS AND LAST IN THE SAVE AS IN THE WILDS. THE RESET UNDOES THEM
PORTAL: BACK TO THE START ISLAND
RESET: UNDOES THE GOALS OF THIS MAP ONLY, TAKES BACK THEIR LETTERS AND LOADS THE MAP AGAIN. THE WILDS ARE LEFT AS THEY ARE
EACH BAY IS ONE GOAL, ITS WAY IN AT THE BOTTOM. THE SIGNS BY THE WAY IN NAME IT. ODRADEK LIVES IN THE ROOM IN THE SOUTH EAST
RINGS: GET A STONE OR A BOULDER INTO THE GAP. THE SIGNATURE IS THE RULES EVERY SOLUTION USES: PUSH, ROLL, ICE, SINK, BUSH
RING 1: ROLL. 2 PUSHES, A BOULDER FILLS THE GAP
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: RURUUURUL
RING 2: ICE. 2 PUSHES, A BOULDER FILLS THE GAP. NOT IN THE WILDS (DRAWN HERE)
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: UULLLUUUUULURR
RING 3: BUSH. 3 PUSHES, A BOULDER FILLS THE GAP
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: LUULULUUURRRRDLLDLDDRDDDRRU
RING 4: PUSH+ROLL. 6 PUSHES, A STONE FILLS THE GAP
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: UUUUUUURRLUURRDDDDRDLLLLL
RING 5: PUSH+ICE. 5 PUSHES, A STONE FILLS THE GAP
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: UUUUUULDDLDRRRRRDRRU
RING 6: PUSH+SINK. 6 PUSHES, A STONE FILLS THE GAP
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: UUUULLUULLLLURURRRDRULLDRRRRRRR
RING 7: PUSH+BUSH. 5 PUSHES, A STONE FILLS THE GAP
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: ULUUURUUURRRRDDDLLLLLLL
RING 8: ROLL+ICE. 2 PUSHES, A BOULDER FILLS THE GAP
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: ULUULLUUULUR
RING 9: ROLL+SINK. 2 PUSHES, A BOULDER FILLS THE GAP
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: UUUUULURULLDR
RING 10: ROLL+BUSH. 3 PUSHES, A BOULDER FILLS THE GAP
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: UUURRRRUDLDDRU
RING 11: PUSH+ROLL+SINK. 5 PUSHES, A STONE FILLS THE GAP
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: UUUULLLUUULURUULLDDRRRRRRR
RING 12: PUSH+ROLL+BUSH. 6 PUSHES, A STONE FILLS THE GAP. NOT IN THE WILDS (DRAWN HERE)
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: UUURRUDLDDRUUUUUUU
RING 13: PUSH+ICE+SINK. 6 PUSHES, A STONE FILLS THE GAP. NOT IN THE WILDS (DRAWN HERE)
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: ULLLDLLLURRULDLLUUUU
RING 14: PUSH+ICE+BUSH. 4 PUSHES, A STONE FILLS THE GAP
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: UURUUULLURRDDRDLLLL
RING 15: ROLL+ICE+BUSH. 3 PUSHES, A BOULDER FILLS THE GAP
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: UUUULLLUURRRDLLDRR
RING 16: ROLL+SINK+BUSH. 5 PUSHES, A BOULDER FILLS THE GAP
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: UULLLUUUURURRRRUDLLLLURUUURRRRDDD
RING 17: PUSH+ROLL+ICE+SINK. 6 PUSHES, A STONE FILLS THE GAP. NOT IN THE WILDS (DRAWN HERE)
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: UULUUDRUUURULDDDLLUUUU
RING 18: PUSH+ROLL+SINK+BUSH. 5 PUSHES, A BOULDER FILLS THE GAP. NOT IN THE WILDS (DRAWN HERE)
SOLUTION, FROM THE CELL INSIDE THE WAY IN: LUUUUURRRRDRRDLLLULLLLLDDRRRDRU
ODD ONES: ONE OF EACH ARRANGEMENT IS NOT QUITE LIKE THE OTHERS. BUMP IT
RESET: UNDOES THE GOALS OF THIS MAP ONLY
ODD ONE: TULIP. A ROW OF TULIPS LEANING ONE WAY, ONE LEANS THE OTHER
THE ODD ONE: THE 2ND FROM THE TOP
ODD ONE: TOADSTOOL. A FAIRY RING OF TOADSTOOLS, ONE IS UPSIDE DOWN
THE ODD ONE: THE 8TH CLOCKWISE FROM THE LEFT ONE AT THE TOP
ODD ONE: STONEBIRD. A FLOCK OF STONE BIRDS LOOKING ONE WAY, ONE LOOKS THE OTHER
THE ODD ONE: THE 2ND ACROSS, THE 2ND DOWN
ODD ONE: MENHIR. A ROW OF STANDING STONES, ONE IS CRACKED
THE ODD ONE: THE 3RD FROM THE LEFT
ODD ONE: POST. A ROW OF POSTS, ONE LEANS
THE ODD ONE: THE 5TH FROM THE TOP
ODD ONE: CAIRN. A ROW OF CAIRNS OF THREE STONES, ONE HAS FOUR
THE ODD ONE: THE 3RD FROM THE LEFT
ODD ONE: ARROWSTONE. A GRID OF FLAT STONES WITH AN ARROW, ONE POINTS ASIDE
THE ODD ONE: THE 2ND ACROSS, THE 3RD DOWN
ODRADEK: THIS ONE IS ALWAYS HERE. GO NEAR AND IT SCUTTLES OFF TO ANOTHER CORNER. STAND BY IT AND FACE IT TO HEAR IT
ONE MORE ODRADEK TURNS UP FOR EACH GOAL DONE, HERE OR IN THE WILDS. THE FIRST IN THE HALL OF WAYSTONES: THE PORTAL BY THE WAY IN
